Write a model as JSON

Source: R/write.R
sbml_write_json.Rd

Writes the sbml_model object as JSON with the zujson package, for use without XML: one array of records per element kind, math as R code (as sbml_math() shows it), notes and annotation as XML text.

Usage

sbml_write_json(m, path = NULL)

Arguments

m

An sbml_model.

path

A file to write, or NULL to return the document as a string.

Value

The path, invisibly, or the JSON as a string when path is NULL.

Examples

m <- sbml_read(system.file("extdata", "decay.xml", package = "zusbml"))
cat(substr(sbml_write_json(m), 1, 200))
#> {
#>   "level": 3,
#>   "version": 2,
#>   "id": "decay",
#>   "name": "decay",
#>   "substance_units": null,
#>   "time_units": null,
#>   "volume_units": null,
#>   "area_units": null,
#>   "length_units": null,
#>   "extent_uni
